_doc: Per-file line-coverage baselines (whole percent points) PLUS the excluded_files allowlist for source files that produce NO LCOV records (static-only modules, feature-gated tiers CI doesn't enable). Both lists are consulted by scripts/coverage_ratchet.py; every source file in crates/*/src/**/*.rs must appear in exactly one. See docs/COVERAGE.md.

excluded_files.crates/rubund/src/lib.rs: single-line `pub mod parser;` — no executable code
all `#[used] static` declarations — no executable lines for LCOV to instrument; closes the gap flagged on PR #274
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/http_server.rs: behind the `_http_server` Cargo feature; the default CI coverage run uses default features
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/stdlib_vendor.rs: behind the `stdlib` Cargo feature; default CI build excludes
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/vm/cext_wasi.rs: cfg(target_os = "wasi") gated; only compiled on wasm32-wasip1, not on the Linux coverage runner
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/vm/fiber.rs: behind the `_fiber` Cargo feature; the default CI coverage run uses default features (matches the http_server / stdlib pattern above)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/json_native.rs: behind the `_json_native` Cargo feature (serde_json accelerator for the pure JSON canon, ADR 0019 Rule 6); default CI build excludes
